I've decided to unmortgage Reading Railroad, leaving me with $980. My current plan is to leverage this move against Player 2, who is in a vulnerable position. This increases to between $970 and $1,070 after passing Go, which is still higher than the max rent on the Pink Monopoly before passing Go! If Player 2 lands on my railroads, they'll have to pay.
